newsitem.title: USA: SEMI reports 33 percent increase in semiconductor.
newsitem.headline: SEMI reports 33 percent increase in semiconductor.

text.p: Worldwide semiconductor capital equipment sales totaled $14.4 billion for the first six months of 1996, up 33 percent from last year when worldwide sales reached $10.9 billion, according to Semiconductor Equipment and Materials International (SEMI).

Expectations and early trend indicators show a slower rate for semiconductor capital equipment shipments for the second half of 1996, which is still expected to show overall annual sales growth of about 20 percent worldwide, it said.
SEMI is a global trade association whose member companies are the equipment and materials suppliers to semiconductor and flat panel display manufacturers.
